lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: سَٰمِدُونَ is in the derivative form: سامِد
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
س/م/د   s–m–d to be elevated, to raise the head and thrust out the chest in pride; to be heedless; to be playful; to be careless. Of this root, only سامِدون sāmidūn occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
سامِد sāmid [act. part.] (one who is) proud; playful; rejoicing; heedless

(53:59–61) أَفَمِنْ‏ ‏هَذَا‏ ‏الْحَدِيثِ‏ ‏تَعْجَبُونَ‏ وَتَضْحَكُونَ‏ ‏وَلاَ‏ ‏تَبْكُونَ‏ وَأَنْتُمْ‏ ‏سَامِدُونَ‏‏ do you marvel at this statement, laughing heedlessly instead of weeping, and playfully amusing yourselves?
